description: The actual critical path from G0 to G11. Where parallel work is possible, marked as parallel. Principal project KPI: NEXT_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE_ACHIEVED (NOT lines of code, feature count, document count, or test count).

critical_path.EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: technical integration evidence || executed custodian agreement + live backing evidence
